svg.text: Conceptual architecture • Primary region: me-west1 (Tel Aviv) • Production environment
Reference data source and CI/CD control plane
Regional deployment • three-zone application tier • managed data services
Private GKE nodes • firewall controls • private service connectivity
3 zones • HPA / Cluster Autoscaler • Pod anti-affinity • PDB
Create Submission ID • issue Signed URL
Nightly delta sync from on-prem SQL Server over HA VPN
Staging → validation → promote to reference data
Continue with Last Known Good Data during outage
Per-workload least privilege • short-lived credentials • no SA keys
Cloud Audit Logs • budget / SLO alerts
Browser → Incoming: direct upload with short-lived Signed URL
Conditional on security, legal and data-owner approval
VPC / networking • regional GKE deployment • Artifact Registry access
Promote database → verify / restore objects → deploy GKE
Validate services and data → update DNS
Agree and validate RTO / RPO targets
Azure DevOps Server is source of truth • GitHub is used for assignment submission only
Dev / Test / Staging • synthetic data only
WIF subject to OIDC compatibility POC
Agent retrieves source / pipeline from on-prem DevOps
HA VPN → private GKE control plane (deploy)
• Pub/Sub is at-least-once; Worker processing is idempotent.
• Retry with bounded backoff; exhausted messages go to DLQ.
• Only validated Clean objects emit processing events.
• Reconciliation detects stuck / missing jobs and repairs state.
• Expand/Contract DB migrations; rollback to prior image digest.
• Build, deploy and workload identities are separate.
• Validate Azure DevOps OIDC / WIF and private network paths.
• DR: test restore, replica promotion, object recovery and DNS.
• Approve cross-region data transfer with security / data owner.
bindings, WIF claims, replication mode and
RTO / RPO are validated in detailed design.
Architecture view is conceptual. Validate service availability, IAM, network paths, replication behavior and operational runbooks before implementation.
